inputs.question: What sentence did the court impose?
inputs.formDestination: Form 31(a) Section V, item 1 (Other Information for the Court), or a clearly labeled attached continuation if the answer does not fit.

inputs.question: What is the class of each conviction listed in Section I?
inputs.formDestination: Add the class beside its matching conviction in Form 31(a) Section I; use the Section I count continuation immediately after Form 31(a) when needed.

inputs.question: Have all probation or sentence conditions been fulfilled, have you been discharged, and on what date?
inputs.formDestination: Answer the printed Form 31(a) Section II compliance choices and put the completion/discharge date in Form 31(a) Section V, item 1, or on a clearly labeled attached continuation.

inputs.question: Do you request a certificate of second chance with this application?
